scope: Frozen v1 masks. Each scenario averages eligible forecast origins, seed replicas averaged per physical configuration. Distributions pool eligible physical configurations; one fixed test fold per training size; headline percentages are ratios of grouped means in learning-curve.json. Ties use 1e-12 + 1e-6*baseline MAE. Event timing uses positive gas only, raw states retained for invalidity; undefined timing explicitly counted. No training or test-driven selection.
